import json,yaml
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('.')
manifest=yaml.safe_load((root/'docs/handoff/2026-09-13-ASTRA-findings-manifest.yaml').read_text())
report=yaml.safe_load((root/'docs/handoff/2026-09-13-ASTRA-PASS-A-results.yaml').read_text())
ledger=json.loads((root/'docs/evidence/astra-pass-a/commands.json').read_text())
ids=[c['id'] for group in ['defect_claims','good_claims','premise_claims'] for c in manifest[group]]
records=report['findings']
assert [r['finding_id'] for r in records]==ids
assert len(ids)==len(set(ids))==20
required={'finding_id','new_verdict','confidence','claim','mechanism','evidence','controls','instrument_audit','refuted_subclaims','remaining_uncertainty','what_would_change_verdict'}
for claim,record in zip([c for group in ['defect_claims','good_claims','premise_claims'] for c in manifest[group]],records):
    assert required <= record.keys()
    assert record['claim']['exact_text']==claim['claim_verbatim']
    assert record['claim']['cited_locations_as_given']==claim['cited_locations']
    assert record['new_verdict'] in {'CONFIRMED','REFUTED','UNPROVABLE-WITHOUT-DEPLOY'}
    assert record['evidence']['commands']
    for evidence_id,entry in zip(record['evidence']['evidence_ids'],record['evidence']['commands']):
        assert entry==ledger['commands'][evidence_id], evidence_id
        assert entry['cwd'].startswith('/') and isinstance(entry['exit_code'],int)
        assert {'command','environment','stdout','stderr'} <= entry.keys()
    if record['finding_id'].startswith('PREMISE-'):
        assert record['dependent_session_scope']['direction'] in {'grow','shrink','stand'}
assert report['manifest_reconciliation']['order_matches'] is True
assert not report['manifest_reconciliation']['missing_ids']
assert len(report['run_metadata']['inspected_files']['all_local_application_files_AST_inspected'])==137
print('VALIDATED: 20 unique manifest IDs, exact claim text and citation lists, required fields, 57 raw evidence entries, resolved command anchors, four premise-scope decisions, no omissions.')
print('VERDICTS:', ', '.join(r['finding_id']+'='+r['new_verdict'] for r in records))
